slides.title: THE BODY IS MADE OF CELLS
content: Your body contains nearly 50 trillion cells
Every heartbeat, thought, movement and emotion depends on cellular energy.

slides.title: CELLULAR VOLTAGE
points: Every healthy cell carries an electrical charge
Average membrane voltage: 70-100 mV = Optimal vitality
slides.visual_description: Cell membrane with electricity running through it and data charts in the background.

slides.title: 3.5 TRILLION VOLTS
slides.equation: 50 Trillion Cells × 0.07 Volts = 3.5 Trillion Volts of Bioelectric Potential
slides.conclusion: Your body is one of the most advanced electrical systems in existence.
slides.visual_description: Glowing human body with electricity radiating outward.
